column1: # The lines an account run prints in fleet mode (gird-check.sh --account-run, gird-check.ps1
# -AccountRun), one per key, in this order, and nothing else. Root on a Mac (gird-fleet.sh) and
# gird-fleet.ps1 read them in this order and refuse any other; each reader checks a value by its key,
# against the lists of its own OS. One key a line. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh, which writes
# the keys into gird-fleet.sh and gird-fleet.ps1 and fails when the lines gird-check.sh or
# gird-check.ps1 prints are not these, in this order.
#   key     the key: lowercase letters and _
